mintAuthority.summary: USTB has independently evidenced native issuance surfaces on Ethereum and Solana. The Ethereum issuer EOA controls the token proxy's direct mint path and ProxyAdmin, while the Solana Token-2022 mint has a live issuer mint authority held by a System Program-owned account. Plume is conservatively treated as an Ethereum-issued bridge representation: its owner-only mint/bulkMint and upgrade paths are reviewed as bridge-representation controls under bridgeRouteRisk because the evidence does not prove independent local Plume liabilities.

controls.label: USTB token owner / ProxyAdmin owner
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294990, eth_getCode returned '0x' (no bytecode), confirming an EOA. This issuer-context EOA is consistent with enterprise MPC/HSM custody and owns both the token and ProxyAdmin paths.

controls.label: USTB Solana Token-2022 mint authority
controls.capDescription: The finalized Token-2022 mint read returned live mintAuthority with supply 224,119.498751 USTB; no program or multisig cap was evidenced. The mint-authority account is System Program-owned. Solana freezeAuthority, permanent delegate, and default-frozen controls remain holder-transfer concerns in their owning risk review and are not part of native Mint Authority.
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 439721950, Token-2022 mint CCz3SGVziFeLYk2xfEstkiqJfYkjaSWb2GCABYsVcjo2 reported mintAuthority EfkJFKtVcpo8sgQGWLoaYcutxNdmqed81wdCcpn7egdz and supply 224,119.498751 USTB. The authority account is System Program-owned, so it is represented as a direct native minter; freezeAuthority and permanent-delegate state are intentionally left outside Mint Authority.

review.evidence: USTB has independently evidenced native issuance surfaces on Ethereum and Solana. Ethereum is an upgradeable token proxy whose issuer EOA owns both token and ProxyAdmin; Solana Token-2022 has live mintAuthority EfkJFKtVcpo8sgQGWLoaYcutxNdmqed81wdCcpn7egdz in finalized slot 439721950, with the authority account owned by the System Program. The Plume proxy is separately deployed and exposes owner-only mint/bulkMint, ProxyAdmin 0xa5df717b304a50838c72cd310c8df636b1aecfa3, and the same issuer EOA owner at block 87678057, but the evidence does not establish independent local liabilities rather than bridge destination issuance. Its bridge-mint, pause, peer-configuration, admin, and upgrade powers are therefore scored under bridgeRouteRisk. The two native issuance surfaces support the retained unbounded, periodic, attestation-only posture. FreezeAuthority, permanent delegate, and default-frozen state remain outside Mint Authority.
